| 指标 | 值 |
|------|-----|

| F1 macro | 78.94% |
| F1 fail | 66.12% (P=86.3%, R=53.6%) |

| Gap vs majority | +10.87pp |

## Val Sweep 完整趋势 (8B s42)

| Checkpoint | Accuracy | 变化 |
|-----------|----------|------|
| ckpt-1000 | 88.23% | — |
| ckpt-1200 | 87.76% | -0.47 |
| ckpt-1400 | 85.97% | -1.79 |
| **ckpt-1600** | **86.75%** | **+0.78** |
